items.title: Port Vale boss was braced for the sack but has now won EIGHT in a row at home
items.description: It was mid-September and Port Vale had just lost to Walsall. It was grim. “Our second half was probably the poorest we had been,” Jon Brady tells Sky Sports. They were in the bottom three. No team in League Two had scored fewer goals. He expected the sack.
